evidence_text: Holidify page for Marina Beach, Chennai shows a 4.3 out of 5 star rating based on 82 votes.
justification: Source states: 4.3/5 based on 82 votes (directly fetched page). Note: Tripadvisor also lists Marina Beach with a large review volume (search snippets suggested figures ranging from ~4,000 to ~62,000+ reviews across different aggregators/listings, e.g. Justdial shows 62,855 ratings), but attempts to fetch Tripadvisor's own attraction page directly returned HTTP 403 (blocked), and WebSearch summaries for the Tripadvisor rating were inconsistent/contradictory across queries (e.g. one search reported 3.8/5 with 4,022 reviews, which could not be verified against the actual page), so those numbers were not used. The Holidify figure is the only number confirmed via a directly and successfully fetched public page.

rating_scale_note: out of 5 (Google Maps rating, as displayed on Wanderlog's Fort St. George Museum page)
evidence_text: Wanderlog's page for Fort St. George Museum (the museum inside the Fort St. George complex, the part of the fort open to visitors) shows two ratings: Google Maps 4.3/5 based on 6,123 reviews, and Tripadvisor 3.6/5 based on 167 reviews.
justification: Source states: Google Maps rating 4.3 out of 5 with 6,123 reviews (directly fetched page, listing both Google and Tripadvisor figures side by side). A separate WebSearch also independently reported Fort St. George on Tripadvisor as '3.6 out of 5 bubbles with 230 reviews,' consistent in the rating value (3.6) though the review count differed slightly (230 vs 167), likely because 'Fort St. George' and 'Fort St. George Museum' are sometimes listed as separate/overlapping Tripadvisor entries. Google Maps figure (4.3/6123) was chosen as primary because it came from a directly fetched, larger-sample listing.

rating_scale_note: out of 5 (Google Maps rating, as displayed on Wanderlog)
evidence_text: Wanderlog's page for Kapaleeshwarar Temple shows a Google Maps rating of 4.8 out of 5 based on 11,037 reviews.
justification: Source states: 4.8/5 based on 11,037 reviews, sourced from Google Maps and displayed on a directly fetched public page. Tripadvisor separately lists Kapaleeshwarar Temple with 2,589-2,590 reviews and is ranked #4-5 of ~476 things to do in Chennai (via WebSearch), but a specific Tripadvisor star rating could not be reliably confirmed (one search result implausibly reported '5.05 of 5 bubbles', which is not a valid Tripadvisor scale value and was discarded as an unreliable/garbled search summary). The Google Maps figure via Wanderlog is used as it was directly verified on a successfully fetched page.

rating_scale_note: out of 5 (Google Maps rating, as displayed on Wanderlog)
evidence_text: Wanderlog's page for Santhome Cathedral Basilica shows a Google Maps rating of 4.7 out of 5 based on 16,903 reviews.
justification: Source states: 4.7/5 based on 16,903 reviews, sourced from Google Maps and displayed on a directly fetched public page. This is corroborated by Tripadvisor, which a WebSearch reported as showing '4.4 of 5 bubbles based on 1,262 reviews, ranked #8 of 477 things to do in Chennai' -- a consistent, plausible figure though not independently fetched from the live Tripadvisor page (blocked with 403). Both sources agree the attraction is highly rated; the Google Maps figure is used as primary since it was directly confirmed on a fetched page.

evidence_text: A WebSearch query for the Tripadvisor listing reported: 'The Government Museum in Chennai has a rating of 3.7 out of 5 bubbles based on 373 reviews and is ranked #41 of 477 things to do in Chennai.'
justification: Source states: 3.7/5 based on 373 reviews. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: direct fetches of the live Tripadvisor page returned HTTP 403 (blocked) for this and every other place, so this number comes only from a WebSearch results summary rather than a directly verified page load, and could not be cross-checked against the raw page. Other sources gave partial, non-comparable signals: a directly fetched Mappls.com listing showed 4.0/5 from only 6 reviews (too small a sample to be reliable), and Justdial listings (not directly fetchable, 403) mentioned '4-star rating' alongside review-count listings of 17,644 and 19,694 ratings but without a precise decimal value. Given the inconsistency across sources and inability to directly verify any of them, this entry is reported with reduced confidence.

evidence_text: A Google search summary (Google Maps listing) reported: 'Guindy National Park has a rating of 4.1 stars with "Very good" status based on 25,388 reviews on Google Maps.' Tripadvisor listing (g304556-d2651336) exists with many individual reviews but the numeric aggregate rating/review-count was not visible in normal search snippets (direct page fetch returned HTTP 403). Justdial also lists the park with a rating of approximately 4.2 based on ~27,000-29,000 ratings, but the exact count was inconsistent across two separate lookups (27,872 vs 29,084), so it was not used as primary.
justification: Source states: Google Maps rating 4.1/5 based on 25,388 reviews, surfaced consistently via a dedicated web search for the listing.

evidence_text: Justdial listing title and summary: 'Arignar Anna Zoological Park Reviews, Vandalur, Chennai - 72,016 Ratings - Justdial', with a rating of 4.2 out of 5. Tripadvisor listing (g304556-d3613690) confirms the attraction has 478 individual written reviews and is ranked #23 of 475 things to do in Chennai, but no numeric star/bubble rating was visible in search snippets or the (403-blocked) page fetch. MouthShut separately lists 3.27/5 for this attraction (different, smaller user base).
justification: Source states: Justdial rating 4.2/5 based on 72,016 ratings, the most numerous and specific figure found across sources for this place.

evidence_text: Web search summary for the Tripadvisor listing (g304556-d2665502) reported: 'Valluvar Kottam Monument has a rating of 3.3 out of 5 bubbles on TripAdvisor, based on 88 reviews.' Direct page fetch was blocked (HTTP 403), so this is taken from the search-result summary of the live page rather than independently re-verified. justification: Source states: Tripadvisor rating 3.3/5 based on 88 reviews, per the search engine's summary of the live Tripadvisor page (preferred per task instructions to favor Tripadvisor when accessible via normal search).

evidence_text: A Google search summary reported: 'the average rating of this place is 4.10 out of 5 stars based on 2556 reviews' for B.M. Birla Planetarium, Chennai. Tripadvisor listing (g304556-d325397, 'B M Birla Planaturium') separately shows 125 traveler reviews with mixed sentiment (praise for the 3D show, criticism of maintenance), but no numeric aggregate rating was visible in search snippets (direct fetch returned HTTP 403). Justdial lists 3,155 ratings for this location without a clearly stated score in search snippets.
justification: Source states: Google Maps rating 4.1/5 based on 2,556 reviews, the most specific and complete figure found for this place.

evidence_text: Web search summary stated: 'On MouthShut, it is rated 3.5/5 by users' for Semmozhi Poonga, but no total review count was given in the snippet. Tripadvisor listing (g304556-d8015909) shows the park ranked #60 of 475 things to do in Chennai with 70 reviews, but no reliable numeric star/bubble rating could be confirmed (one search summary claimed '5.0 out of 5 bubbles', which is not credible as an aggregate score and was discarded as likely a misread of a single 5-bubble review rather than the overall rating; direct page fetch was blocked with HTTP 403). A Justdial result for 'Semmozhi Poonga Parking' showed 3.8/5 from 45 ratings, but this appears to be a sub-listing for the parking area rather than the garden itself, so it was not used.
justification: Source states: MouthShut rating 3.5/5 (no review count disclosed in the search snippet); review_count left null because no reliable count could be attributed specifically to this attraction's overall garden listing across the sources checked.

source: Tripadvisor (via Wanderlog aggregator page, since Tripadvisor's own pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch)
evidence_text: Wanderlog's aggregator page for 'Edward Elliot's Beach' (Besant Nagar, Chennai) displays: Tripadvisor 4.1 out of 5 stars from 2,107 reviews; Google 4.4 out of 5 stars from 8,282 reviews. justification: Source states: Tripadvisor 4.1/5 from 2,107 reviews (Wanderlog aggregator, cross-checked against an independent Tripadvisor search snippet showing ~2,109 reviews for the same listing).

rating_scale_note: out of 5 (Tripadvisor) -- same physical beach/listing as P11 (Elliot's Beach), Tripadvisor and other sources treat 'Besant Nagar Beach' and 'Edward Elliot's Beach' as the same attraction (sometimes even the same listing ID, e.g. tripadvisor g304556-d1785664 / d4152199)
evidence_text: Wanderlog's page specifically titled 'Besant Nagar Beach' shows Google rating 4.5/5 from 41,541 reviews, but does not surface a distinct Tripadvisor number on that page (only a link to 'All Tripadvisor reviews'). Because Tripadvisor itself (and most travel sites) list Besant Nagar Beach and Edward Elliot's Beach as the same physical attraction/listing, the Tripadvisor figure of 4.1/5 from 2,107 reviews found for P11 is reused here per task instructions allowing identical numbers for this same-place duplicate entry. The much larger Google figure (4.5/5, 41,541 reviews) is recorded separately below in evidence_text for transparency but not used as the primary rating field to keep the source consistent with P11 (Tripadvisor).
justification: Source states: same Tripadvisor listing/attraction as P11 (Elliot's Beach) -> 4.1/5 from 2,107 reviews; Google Maps listing separately shows 4.5/5 from 41,541 reviews (noted in evidence_text, not used as primary value).

evidence_text: Holidify's page for Dakshinachitra Museum shows a rating of 3.0 out of 5 stars based on 33 votes, ranked #9 among Things To Do in Chennai. Note: Tripadvisor's own listing (g303893-d2062837, 'DakshinaChitra Museum', Muttukadu) could not be fetched directly (HTTP 403), but a normal web_search surfaced a review-category breakdown for that listing of 416 total reviews (217 Excellent, 155 Very good, 34 Average, 6 Poor, 4 Terrible), which is qualitatively much more positive than Holidify's 3.0/5 -- this discrepancy across sources is reported as-is rather than resolved by computing our own average. Justdial search-snippet summaries claimed a 4.3 rating from 19,059 reviews, but this number could not be verified from the Justdial page itself (fetch returned HTTP 403) and the review count seems implausibly high for a single heritage museum, so it was not used.
justification: Source states: Holidify -- 'Dakshinachitra Museum has a rating of 3.0 out of 5 stars, based on 33 votes.' Used as the primary reported figure since it is a directly confirmed number from a normally-loadable public page; conflicting/unverifiable figures from Tripadvisor (review-breakdown only, page itself blocked) and Justdial (blocked, implausible count) are recorded in evidence_text but not used as the headline number.
